Jan, 1988 The Soviet Union is increasingly concerned with American and Japanese presence near the Sea of Okhtosk.
Japan is rapidly improving its "self-defense" forces, and the Kremlin suspects Japan has rekindled its territorial ambitions. Meanwhile, the Iran-Iraq War's recent conclusion has allowed much of US 7th Fleet's Indian Ocean squadrons to return to the Western Pacific. A resurgent Japan and the surge of US forces has convinced Moscow to send a bold message.
SF Klyuchevskaya is ordered to patrol the Kuril Islands and demonstrate Soviet resolve. Centered on TAKVR MINSK, it is a powerful task force that will reassert the will of the Soviet people.
Build your task group, protect MINSK and defend the Motherland.
